en: A black-and-white nighttime photograph showing fireworks bursting above a lit hilltop monument, the Acropolis. The Parthenon and surrounding structures are illuminated while arcs of fireworks rise and fall against the dark sky. At the bottom is a white border containing printed text in Greek and French, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible across the lower right portion of the image.
